line: Crowley’s Two of Wands: Dominion, Mars in its own sign Aries, placed at Chokmah.

sections.title: What Crowley names
sections.line: The chapter name for the card, from the Aces-to-Twos essay. The second quotation gives the element of its suit.

quotes.quote: The Two of Wands is called the Lord of Dominion
“Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;

sections.title: Its place on the Tree and in the zodiac
sections.line: The Twos are Chokmah in the tree essay, which also gives the first decan of Aries ruled by Mars. The card’s own chapter names Mars in his own sign Aries.

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the first Decan of the fiery sign Aries, which is ruled by Mars; this, then, gives the idea of a violent and aggressive force.
The background of this card shows the power of the planet Mars in his own sign Aries,

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley’s account of the Will in its most exalted form and of the image of crossed dorjes.

quotes.quote: This card, pertaining to Chokmah in the suit of Fire, represents the Will in its most exalted form.
The pictorial representation is two Dorjes crossed.
